name: DON'T TELL AMMA || Stand up Special || Sumukhi Suresh
description: Don’t Tell Amma is stand up comedian, actor and writer Sumukhi Suresh’s first stand up special. She talks about growing up poor in Nagpur but with a rich people resume, the truth about Nutella and Khichdi and most importantly about her wildcat Amma not knowing about her on stage pursuits.
